title: Compute Albon-Dunning step velocity curves
action: Implement the Albon-Dunning formula V = V0 * (d - (1-c)*d + (1-c)) * (1-c)^d with V0=5.8e-7 m/s. Compute V for c from 0.0 to 1.0 in steps of 0.01 for critical nucleus diameters d=2, 6, 10. Output a CSV file with columns c, V_d2, V_d6, V_d10.
description: Velocity vs. coverage curves for the Albon-Dunning model at three critical nucleus sizes.
output_schema: Columns: c (float), V_d2 (float), V_d6 (float), V_d10 (float). Rows for c from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.01.

title: Compute Cabrera-Vermilyea step velocity curves
action: Implement the three Cabrera-Vermilyea formulas: squeezing-only V = V0 * sqrt(1 - d * sqrt(x)), surface-flux-reduction V = V0 * (1 - x), and combined V = V0 * (1 - x) * sqrt(1 - d * sqrt(x)). Use V0=5.8e-7 m/s. Compute V for x from 0.0 to 1.0 in steps of 0.001 for squeezing-only with d=2,5,10, and for flux-reduction and combined with d=2. Output a CSV with columns x, V_squeezing_d2, V_squeezing_d5, V_squeezing_d10, V_flux_d2, V_flux_d5, V_flux_d10, V_combined_d2, V_combined_d5, V_combined_d10.
description: Velocity vs. ledge adsorbate density curves for the Cabrera-Vermilyea models.
output_schema: Columns: x (float), V_squeezing_d2 (float), V_squeezing_d5 (float), V_squeezing_d10 (float), V_flux_d2 (float), V_flux_d5 (float), V_flux_d10 (float), V_combined_d2 (float), V_combined_d5 (float), V_combined_d10 (float). Rows for x from 0.0 to 1.0 in steps of 0.001 (handle 1 - d*sqrt(x) < 0 by outputting 0.0).

title: Conclude on plateau absence
action: Examine the computed velocity-coverage curves from the preceding two steps. Assess whether any of the curves exhibits a plateau region (a range of non-zero coverage over which the step velocity remains constant at its pure-solution value V0, or any other constant non-zero value). Write a one-line ASCII text file stating explicitly whether a plateau is observed.
description: A single-line text file stating whether a plateau region is observed in any of the computed velocity-coverage curves.
output_schema: Exactly one line of ASCII text, e.g., 'No plateau region observed in any of the calculated curves.'
